meta.name: School Tales the Series
meta.description:
Unspeakable horrors roam the halls of high school in this anthology featuring ghost stories directed by seasoned Thai horror directors.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 10 Aug 2022 · Thailand · Language: Thai · 48 min
Studio: Five Star Production · Network: Netflix

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

On your server — Audio: Thai

videos.title: 7AM
videos.overview: A student unwilingly arrives early to class to warn his classmate about different messages that appear on the blackboard every morning.

videos.title: Vengeful Spell
videos.overview: After uncovering a box in the school's attic, a student puts a curse on a rival out of sheer jealousy.

videos.title: Beautiful
videos.overview: The most popular girl in school meets her match after a fellow student suddenly turns beautiful overnight.

videos.title: The Book of Corpses
videos.overview: A transfer student writes down a curse against bullies in a mysterious library book, causing dire consequences.

videos.title: The Headless Teacher
videos.overview: A pair of mischievous students look into the mysterious death of a teacher by helping to locate her missing head.

videos.title: Lunch
videos.overview: An overeager student stirs up trouble when he exposes the truth behind the ingredients at a popular school lunch stall.

videos.title: The Curse
videos.overview: Terrifying incidents occur after bullies force a smart but cowardly student to make a wish to a school nurse ghost.

videos.title: A Walk in School
videos.overview: At night, a gutsy student livestreams his investigation of his high school to prove that ghost stories aren't real.
